resources.string: Play, explore, and discover something magical every day.
Solve this quick math puzzle to enter the Parent Dashboard.
AI features are currently paused in Parent Settings. Ask a parent to enable them, or use Offline Teacher Mode!

All learning progress, badges, and daily logs stay locally on this device. This app has zero ads, no social links, and no in-app purchases. Microphone access is used only when your child taps Speak, and Cloud AI Tutor/Art can be paused anytime above.

• Personal Info: We do not collect names, emails, location, or photos.
• Local Storage: Quests, stars, badges, and daily streaks stay stored locally on this device.
• Microphone: Used only when Speak is tapped in voice games, with a full typing fallback.
• Optional Cloud AI: When enabled by a parent above, Professor Hoot sends only the learning question or art idea to Gemini via Firebase AI Logic. Turn the switch off anytime for 100% Offline Mode.
• Child Safety: Zero ads, zero in-app purchases, zero social media links, and math-gated parent controls.
